blocks.zh: Part I：遠端查驗的規劃與通知
blocks.en: Part I: Planning and Notification for Remote Inspections

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解衛生主管機關（HA）如何以風險評估為基礎，決定採用遠端查驗的類型（桌面審查 vs. 虛擬查驗 vs. 混合查驗）
blocks.en: Understand how the health authority (HA) uses risk assessment to decide which type of remote inspection to use (desktop review vs. virtual inspection vs. hybrid inspection)

blocks.zh: 掌握通知時機與起算點的差異：桌面查驗以文件索取為起算，虛擬查驗以開幕會議為起算
blocks.en: Grasp the differences in notification timing and starting point: for a desktop inspection the clock starts with the document request, for a virtual inspection with the opening meeting

blocks.zh: 建立「遠端查驗主持人」（Remote Inspection Host）角色及查驗團隊組成的完整認識
blocks.en: Build a complete understanding of the Remote Inspection Host role and the composition of the inspection team

blocks.zh: 理解遠端查驗在議程規劃、硬體設備、資訊分享平台及技術使用上的具體最佳實務
blocks.en: Understand the specific best practices for remote inspections in agenda planning, hardware, information-sharing platforms and use of technology

blocks.zh: 熟悉查驗前協議（pre-inspection agreement）的法律合規要素，包括錄音錄影限制與資料保護規定
blocks.en: Become familiar with the legal and compliance elements of the pre-inspection agreement, including restrictions on audio and video recording and data protection requirements

blocks.zh: 掌握文件準備、查驗報告分享及文件提交時程的最佳實務，特別是針對 CDMO 多客戶環境的應用
blocks.en: Grasp best practices for document preparation, sharing of inspection reports and document submission timelines, especially as applied in the multi-client CDMO environment

blocks.zh: Topic A.1 — Types of Inspections Performed Remotely（遠端查驗的類型）| p4
blocks.en: Topic A.1 — Types of Inspections Performed Remotely | p4

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — For-Cause 查驗幾乎不適合遠端進行
blocks.en: Key Notes — For-Cause Inspections Are Almost Never Suitable for Remote Conduct

blocks.zh: For-Cause Inspection（專案查驗）：是因特定問題或重大合規疑慮（例如 Warning Letter、重大不良事件）而觸發的查驗，目的在深入調查，非例行性監視。
blocks.en: For-Cause Inspection: An inspection triggered by a specific problem or a serious compliance concern (for example a Warning Letter or a serious adverse event). Its purpose is in-depth investigation rather than routine surveillance.

blocks.zh: 此類查驗需要查驗員能「親眼看到」現場實際狀況，例如：
blocks.en: This type of inspection requires the inspector to "see with their own eyes" the actual situation on site, for example:

blocks.zh: 實地觀察製程操作行為
blocks.en: Observing process operations and operator behavior in person

blocks.zh: 直接查閱原始紙本記錄
blocks.en: Directly reviewing original paper records

blocks.zh: 訪談當事人員並觀察反應
blocks.en: Interviewing the people involved and observing their reactions

blocks.zh: 同樣地，部分 PAI（Pre-Approval Inspection，上市前查驗） 也不適合遠端進行，特別是首次申請的無菌製劑設施。CDMO 在承接新客戶藥品申請時，需留意 HA 是否要求現場 PAI。
blocks.en: Likewise, some PAIs (Pre-Approval Inspections) are not suitable for remote conduct either, especially for the first application involving a sterile product facility. When a CDMO takes on a new client's drug application, it should watch whether the HA requires an on-site PAI.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 就像決定要不要親自去看房
blocks.en: Analogy — Like Deciding Whether to View a House in Person

blocks.zh: 買房時，你可以先看網路上的照片和平面圖（桌面查驗），視訊直播看屋（虛擬查驗），或先視訊看完再親自去簽約（混合查驗）。
blocks.en: When buying a house, you can first look at online photos and floor plans (desktop inspection), watch a live video tour (virtual inspection), or do the video tour first and then go in person to sign (hybrid inspection).

blocks.zh: 但如果這間房子之前被舉報有重大結構問題（for-cause），你絕對不會只靠視訊決定——你一定要親自去。遠端查驗亦同。
blocks.en: But if the house has been reported for serious structural problems (for-cause), you would never decide on video alone; you would definitely go in person. The same applies to remote inspections.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在接受客戶委託生產某新藥的 PAI，HA 表示希望改為虛擬查驗。你會如何評估並回應？
blocks.en: A CDMO is undergoing a PAI for a new drug manufactured on behalf of a client, and the HA says it would like to switch to a virtual inspection. How would you assess and respond?

blocks.zh: 某設施在上次查驗後收到 Warning Letter，現在 HA 通知要進行 follow-up 查驗。根據本節建議，遠端查驗是否適合？為什麼？
blocks.en: A facility received a Warning Letter after its last inspection, and the HA now announces a follow-up inspection. According to the recommendations in this section, is a remote inspection suitable? Why?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 遠端查驗類型選擇矩陣
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Selection Matrix for Remote Inspection Types

blocks.zh: PDA 將遠端查驗依風險高低分為三種類型，各有其適用情境：
blocks.en: PDA divides remote inspections into three types according to risk level, each with its own applicable situations:

blocks.zh: 風險評估考量因素包括：過去查驗結果、製程複雜度、產品關鍵性、是否有其他 HA 查驗歷史可參考。
blocks.en: Factors in the risk assessment include: past inspection results, process complexity, product criticality, and whether the inspection history of other HAs can be referred to.

blocks.zh: Topic B.1 — Notification（通知）| p5
blocks.en: Topic B.1 — Notification | p5

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 收到通知後的 2 週準備清單
blocks.en: Practical Application — 2-Week Preparation Checklist After Receiving Notification

blocks.zh: 當 HA 發出虛擬查驗通知後，建議在 2 週內完成以下準備：
blocks.en: After the HA issues a virtual inspection notice, it is recommended to complete the following preparation within 2 weeks:

blocks.zh: 第 1–2 天：確認 Remote Inspection Host、組建核心團隊、確認 HA 查驗員清單
blocks.en: Days 1–2: Confirm the Remote Inspection Host, form the core team, confirm the list of HA inspectors

blocks.zh: 第 3–5 天：建立並測試文件分享平台；準備查驗員所需帳號或存取連結
blocks.en: Days 3–5: Set up and test the document-sharing platform; prepare the accounts or access links the inspectors need

blocks.zh: 第 5–8 天：整理常規查驗文件包（SOP 清單、CAPA、APR、偏差報告等）並完成 PDF 數位化
blocks.en: Days 5–8: Assemble the routine inspection document package (SOP list, CAPA, APR, deviation reports, etc.) and complete PDF digitization

blocks.zh: 第 9–12 天：執行 30 分鐘技術測試（視訊、文件分享、備用電話線）
blocks.en: Days 9–12: Run a 30-minute technology test (video, document sharing, backup phone line)

blocks.zh: 第 13–14 天：完成議程確認、備份人員分配、法律諮詢確認（若涉及錄影授權）
blocks.en: Days 13–14: Finalize the agenda, assign backup personnel, and confirm legal advice (if recording authorization is involved)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 遠端面試與現場面試的準備差異
blocks.en: Analogy — Preparing for a Remote vs. an In-Person Interview

blocks.zh: 現場面試只需要印幾份履歷帶去就好；但視訊面試前你需要：測試電腦、確認網路、準備好背景、確認音訊。遠端查驗也是同樣道理——技術測試是成功的關鍵前提。
blocks.en: For an in-person interview you only need to print a few copies of your resume and go. For a video interview you need to test the computer, check the internet connection, prepare the background and check the audio. Remote inspection works the same way: the technology test is the key prerequisite for success.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 「查驗起算點」的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Concept — The Key Difference in the "Starting Point of the Inspection"

blocks.zh: 這是遠端查驗中最容易混淆、也最有法規合規意義的一個概念：
blocks.en: This is the concept most easily confused in remote inspections, and also the one with the most regulatory compliance significance:

blocks.zh: 為什麼這很重要？因為 GMP 合規記錄需要明確標示哪些文件是「為查驗準備」的，哪些是「在查驗中提供」的，兩者的法律地位和 GMP 記錄狀態不同。
blocks.en: Why does this matter? Because GMP compliance records need to clearly identify which documents were "prepared for the inspection" and which were "provided during the inspection". The two have different legal status and different GMP record status.

blocks.zh: Topic B.2 — Verification of an Inspector's Identity（查驗員身分驗證）| p6
blocks.en: Topic B.2 — Verification of an Inspector's Identity | p6

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 冒充查驗員的工業間諜風險
blocks.en: Key Notes — The Industrial Espionage Risk of Inspector Impersonation

blocks.zh: 這不是理論上的威脅。2009 年 FDA 就曾公開警告有人冒充 FDA 查驗員進行詐騙，目的是取得製造商的機密記錄、商業秘密和配方資訊。
blocks.en: This is not a theoretical threat. In 2009 the FDA publicly warned that people were impersonating FDA inspectors in order to commit fraud, with the aim of obtaining manufacturers' confidential records, trade secrets and formulation information.

blocks.zh: 在遠端查驗情境下，風險更高，因為：
blocks.en: In a remote inspection the risk is higher, because:

blocks.zh: 無法現場核查實體證件（官方 ID card）
blocks.en: Physical credentials (the official ID card) cannot be checked on site

blocks.zh: 視訊畫面可以偽造身分背景
blocks.en: A video feed can fake the identity background

blocks.zh: 電子郵件通知可能被仿冒（Phishing）
blocks.en: Email notifications can be spoofed (phishing)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，客戶產品的製程秘密、CMC 數據、批次記錄都是高度敏感資訊，一旦洩漏損失極大。任何不尋常的查驗通知都應先向 HA 官方管道確認。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, clients' process secrets, CMC data and batch records are highly sensitive information, and a leak would cause enormous losses. Any unusual inspection notice should first be confirmed through the HA's official channels.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 就像讓外包商進廠前先查驗資格
blocks.en: Analogy — Like Vetting a Contractor Before Letting Them onto the Site

blocks.zh: 負責任的工廠在讓外部承包商進入管制區域前，一定會核查其公司執照、人員資格證書，而不是看對方說「我是某某公司的人」就放行。
blocks.en: A responsible plant always checks a contractor's business license and personnel qualification certificates before letting them into a controlled area. It does not wave someone through just because they say "I'm from such-and-such company".

blocks.zh: 視訊查驗也是同樣道理：看對方螢幕背景掛著 FDA 的徽章，並不等於對方真的是 FDA 查驗員——打電話去 HA 官方號碼確認，才是正確做法。
blocks.en: The same applies to video inspections: seeing an FDA badge in the background of the other party's screen does not mean they are really an FDA inspector. Calling the HA's official number to confirm is the correct approach.

blocks.zh: 你的公司收到一封聲稱來自 TFDA 的電子郵件，要求立即啟動虛擬查驗，但你之前未收到任何預通知。你的第一步應該是什麼？
blocks.en: Your company receives an email claiming to be from the TFDA, asking you to start a virtual inspection immediately, but you received no prior notification. What should your first step be?

blocks.zh: 請列出貴公司驗證 HA 查驗員身分的 SOP 應包含哪三個核查步驟。
blocks.en: Please list the three verification steps your company's SOP for verifying HA inspector identity should contain.

blocks.zh: Topic C.1 — Remote Inspection Team Formation（遠端查驗團隊組成）| p7–8
blocks.en: Topic C.1 — Remote Inspection Team Formation | p7–8

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Remote Inspection Host 的角色與職權
blocks.en: Key Concept — The Role and Authority of the Remote Inspection Host

blocks.zh: Remote Inspection Host（遠端查驗主持人）是整個遠端查驗流程的核心樞紐。其核心職責包括：
blocks.en: The Remote Inspection Host is the central hub of the whole remote inspection process. Core responsibilities include:

blocks.zh: 作為 HA 與公司之間的唯一聯繫窗口（Single Point of Contact, SPOC）
blocks.en: Acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between the HA and the company

blocks.zh: 確保技術問題（平台當機、連線中斷）能即時找到 IT 支援解決
blocks.en: Making sure technical problems (platform crashes, connection drops) can be resolved immediately by IT support

blocks.zh: 協調文件請求的接收、處理與上傳
blocks.en: Coordinating the receipt, handling and upload of document requests

blocks.zh: 管理多個工作流（workstream）中的人員調度
blocks.en: Managing staff deployment across multiple workstreams

blocks.zh: 在查驗前、中、後維持溝通一致性
blocks.en: Maintaining consistent communication before, during and after the inspection

blocks.zh: 此職位需要充足的職權（adequate authority）——意味著 Host 必須能直接調動資源，而非層層請示。在許多公司，此角色由品質部門的資深主管擔任。
blocks.en: This role requires adequate authority, meaning the Host must be able to mobilize resources directly rather than seek approval layer by layer. In many companies this role is filled by a senior manager from the quality unit.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Host 就像航管中心（Air Traffic Controller）
blocks.en: Analogy — The Host Is Like an Air Traffic Controller

blocks.zh: 想像虛擬查驗是一場複雜的空中交通：HA 查驗員是需要降落的飛機，SMEs 是跑道，文件是燃料，IT 是地面支援。
blocks.en: Imagine a virtual inspection as a complex piece of air traffic: the HA inspectors are the aircraft that need to land, the SMEs are the runways, the documents are the fuel, and IT is the ground support.

blocks.zh: Remote Inspection Host 就是航空管制員——他不親自飛，但他指揮誰降落、何時降落、降落在哪條跑道，確保整個空域不混亂。沒有好的航管，就是空難。
blocks.en: The Remote Inspection Host is the air traffic controller. He does not fly the planes himself, but he directs who lands, when, and on which runway, keeping the whole airspace from descending into chaos. Without good air traffic control, you get a crash.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 遠端查驗團隊組成清單
blocks.en: Practical Application — Remote Inspection Team Composition Checklist for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 以下是 CDMO 建議的遠端查驗團隊配置：
blocks.en: The following is the recommended remote inspection team configuration for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: Remote Inspection Host（具調動 IT 和 QA 資源的職權）
blocks.en: Remote Inspection Host (with authority to mobilize IT and QA resources)

blocks.zh: 查驗帶領人（Designated Leader，負責策略決策）
blocks.en: Designated Leader (responsible for strategic decisions)

blocks.zh: IT 支援人員（現場待命，解決平台問題）
blocks.en: IT support staff (on standby on site to resolve platform problems)

blocks.zh: QA 主管（負責文件審查確認）
blocks.en: QA manager (responsible for confirming document review)

blocks.zh: 生產/製程 SME（各相關部門）
blocks.en: Production/process SMEs (from each relevant department)

blocks.zh: 法規事務代表（協助解讀 HA 問題）
blocks.en: Regulatory affairs representative (to help interpret HA questions)

blocks.zh: 文件管理人員（搜尋、掃描、上傳）
blocks.en: Document control staff (searching, scanning, uploading)

blocks.zh: 備援人員（每個關鍵角色應有備份，以防網路中斷）
blocks.en: Backup personnel (every key role should have a backup in case of a network outage)

blocks.zh: 多客戶 CDMO 特別注意：若同時有不同客戶產品被查驗，需確認客戶保密協議（NDA）是否允許跨產品的 SME 參與同一查驗。
blocks.en: Special note for multi-client CDMOs: If products of different clients are being inspected at the same time, confirm whether the client confidentiality agreements (NDAs) allow SMEs to take part across products in the same inspection.

blocks.zh: Topic C.2 — Planning the Agenda（議程規劃）| p9–10
blocks.en: Topic C.2 — Planning the Agenda | p9–10

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 遠端查驗的「2–3 倍工期」現實
blocks.en: Key Notes — The "2–3 Times the Duration" Reality of Remote Inspections

blocks.zh: 許多公司在首次遠端查驗時大感意外：一個原本預計 4 天的現場查驗，虛擬版本竟然需要 10–14 天。
blocks.en: Many companies are surprised during their first remote inspection: an on-site inspection originally expected to take 4 days needs 10–14 days in its virtual version.

blocks.zh: 原因在於每天有效工作時數縮短（4 小時 vs. 7 小時）加上：
blocks.en: The reason is that effective working hours per day are shorter (4 hours vs. 7 hours), plus:

blocks.zh: 文件數位化和上傳需要額外時間
blocks.en: Digitizing and uploading documents takes extra time

blocks.zh: 連線品質問題造成重複說明
blocks.en: Connection quality problems cause explanations to be repeated

blocks.zh: 時差（若跨國查驗）限制有效工作時段
blocks.en: Time differences (for cross-border inspections) limit the effective working window

blocks.zh: 書面確認取代即興對話，造成迭代來回
blocks.en: Written confirmation replaces spontaneous conversation, causing back-and-forth iterations

blocks.zh: CDMO 規劃建議：對外向客戶溝通遠端查驗的預期工期時，應以現場查驗天數的 2.5 倍作為保守估計，並預留 buffer 處理延伸請求。
blocks.en: Planning recommendation for CDMOs: When communicating the expected duration of a remote inspection to clients, use 2.5 times the number of on-site inspection days as a conservative estimate, and reserve a buffer to handle extended requests.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 文化差異與肢體語言缺失的挑戰
blocks.en: Key Notes — The Challenge of Cultural Differences and the Loss of Body Language

blocks.zh: 這是一個常被忽視但實際上影響查驗結果的「軟性」因素。在現場查驗中，有經驗的查驗員和受查方都會透過肢體語言、表情、語調來判斷對方的信心程度和資訊可信度。
blocks.en: This is a "soft" factor that is often overlooked but does in practice affect inspection outcomes. In an on-site inspection, experienced inspectors and the inspected party both use body language, facial expression and tone of voice to judge the other side's confidence and the credibility of the information.

blocks.zh: 遠端查驗中：
blocks.en: In a remote inspection:

blocks.zh: 視訊畫質限制了面部表情的可讀性
blocks.en: Video quality limits how well facial expressions can be read

blocks.zh: 網路延遲可能被誤解為「刻意停頓」
blocks.en: Network latency may be misread as a "deliberate pause"

blocks.zh: 不同文化對於「沉默」的詮釋不同（東亞文化的沉默可能代表尊重而非迴避）
blocks.en: Different cultures interpret "silence" differently (in East Asian cultures silence may signal respect rather than evasion)

blocks.zh: 語言翻譯在虛擬環境中更難即時確認理解程度
blocks.en: Language interpretation makes it harder to confirm understanding in real time in a virtual environment

blocks.zh: 建議：在開幕會議中主動說明語言和文化背景，並建立明確的「確認理解」機制（例如：每個議題結束後由 Host 總結雙方達成共識的內容）。
blocks.en: Recommendation: Explain the language and cultural background proactively in the opening meeting, and set up a clear "confirmation of understanding" mechanism (for example, after each topic the Host summarizes what both sides have agreed).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 視訊會議的「馬拉松」效應
blocks.en: Analogy — The "Marathon" Effect of Video Meetings

blocks.zh: 現場查驗像跑 10 公里——強度高但快速結束。遠端查驗更像馬拉松——持續時間長，需要配速管理和體能儲備。
blocks.en: An on-site inspection is like a 10 km run: high intensity but over quickly. A remote inspection is more like a marathon: long in duration, requiring pacing and physical reserves.

blocks.zh: 每小時短暫休息、每天議程不超過 4–5 小時、下班前 30 分鐘留給每日收尾總結——這些不是「放鬆」，而是保持長期戰力的策略。
blocks.en: A short break every hour, an agenda of no more than 4–5 hours per day, and the last 30 minutes before close of day reserved for a daily wrap-up: these are not "slacking off" but strategies for sustaining performance over the long run.

blocks.zh: Topic D.1 — Hardware Requirements（硬體需求）| p11–12
blocks.en: Topic D.1 — Hardware Requirements | p11–12

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 文件攝影機（Document Camera）的 CDMO 應用價值
blocks.en: Practical Application — The Value of a Document Camera for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 文件攝影機是遠端查驗中最被低估但效益最高的設備之一。考量以下情境：
blocks.en: The document camera is one of the most underrated yet highest-value pieces of equipment in a remote inspection. Consider the following scenario:

blocks.zh: 一次驗證查驗中，HA 要求審查 3 個 PPQ 批次的批次生產記錄（Batch Manufacturing Records），每本記錄約 200 頁，全部手寫。若靠掃描：
blocks.en: In a validation inspection, the HA asks to review the Batch Manufacturing Records of 3 PPQ batches, each record about 200 pages and entirely handwritten. If you rely on scanning:

blocks.zh: 600 頁 × 平均 30 秒/頁 = 約 5 小時掃描時間
blocks.en: 600 pages × an average of 30 seconds/page = about 5 hours of scanning time

blocks.zh: 加上 PDF 整理、命名、上傳：約 2 小時
blocks.en: Plus PDF organizing, naming and uploading: about 2 hours

blocks.zh: 合計：7 小時額外準備工作
blocks.en: Total: 7 hours of extra preparation work

blocks.zh: 使用文件攝影機：查驗員即時看到原始記錄的任何頁面，無需預先掃描。只有查驗員要求留存的特定頁面才需掃描上傳。
blocks.en: With a document camera: the inspector sees any page of the original record in real time, with no pre-scanning needed. Only the specific pages the inspector asks to retain need to be scanned and uploaded.

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議：每個有實體記錄的查驗站點，都應配備至少一台文件攝影機，並預先測試與視訊平台的相容性。
blocks.en: CDMO recommendation: Every inspection site that holds physical records should be equipped with at least one document camera, and its compatibility with the video platform should be tested in advance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 潔淨室與爆炸性區域的設備管理
blocks.en: Key Notes — Equipment Management for Cleanrooms and Explosive Atmosphere Areas

blocks.zh: 虛擬導覽使用的設備必須通過相關區域的安全與品質認可。這意味著：
blocks.en: Equipment used for virtual tours must be approved for safety and quality for the areas concerned. This means:

blocks.zh: 進入 ISO 5 無菌充填區的設備，必須符合 URS（如不脫落顆粒、可消毒）
blocks.en: Equipment entering the ISO 5 aseptic filling area must meet the URS (for example non-particle-shedding and capable of being disinfected)

blocks.zh: 含有機溶劑的製造區（防爆區），設備需符合 ATEX 或同等防爆規範
blocks.en: In manufacturing areas containing organic solvents (explosion-protected areas), equipment must meet ATEX or an equivalent explosion-protection standard

blocks.zh: 任何臨時引入的設備都需要有書面的設備引入授權（Equipment Introduction Authorization）
blocks.en: Any temporarily introduced equipment requires written Equipment Introduction Authorization

blocks.zh: 提前 2–3 週進行設備進場確認，避免查驗當天才發現設備不符規定。
blocks.en: Carry out equipment entry checks 2–3 weeks in advance, to avoid discovering on the day of the inspection that the equipment does not comply.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 硬體分層：必要 vs. 建議
blocks.en: Key Concept — Hardware Tiers: Required vs. Recommended

blocks.zh: PDA 將硬體分為兩個層次，幫助公司優先配置資源：
blocks.en: PDA divides hardware into two tiers to help companies prioritize resource allocation:

blocks.zh: Topic D.2 — Planning to Share Information（資訊分享規劃）| p13–14
blocks.en: Topic D.2 — Planning to Share Information | p13–14

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 可搜尋 PDF 的合規要求
blocks.en: Key Concept — Compliance Requirements for Searchable PDFs

blocks.zh: 為什麼「可搜尋的 PDF（Searchable PDF）」如此重要？
blocks.en: Why is a "Searchable PDF" so important?

blocks.zh: 查驗員在審查一份 200 頁的批次記錄時，需要快速找到特定偏差編號、參數值或操作人員簽名。如果是掃描圖片（Image-only PDF），查驗員必須逐頁翻閱；但可搜尋 PDF 只需按 Ctrl+F 輸入關鍵字即可定位。
blocks.en: When reviewing a 200-page batch record, an inspector needs to quickly find a specific deviation number, parameter value or operator signature. With an image-only PDF the inspector has to flip through page by page, but with a searchable PDF a keyword entered with Ctrl+F is enough to locate it.

blocks.zh: 如何產生可搜尋 PDF？
blocks.en: How to produce a searchable PDF?

blocks.zh: 直接從電子系統（如 MES、QMS）匯出：天然可搜尋
blocks.en: Export directly from electronic systems (such as MES, QMS): inherently searchable

blocks.zh: 掃描紙本文件：使用具 OCR（光學文字辨識）功能的掃描器
blocks.en: Scanning paper documents: use a scanner with OCR (optical character recognition)

blocks.zh: 事後處理：使用 Adobe Acrobat 的 OCR 功能轉換
blocks.en: Post-processing: convert using the OCR function in Adobe Acrobat

blocks.zh: CDMO 採購掃描設備時，OCR 功能應列為必要規格。
blocks.en: When a CDMO purchases scanning equipment, OCR capability should be listed as a mandatory specification.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 電子郵件不應作為大量文件分享方式
blocks.en: Key Notes — Email Should Not Be Used for Bulk Document Sharing

blocks.zh: 使用電子郵件傳送查驗文件的問題：
blocks.en: Problems with sending inspection documents by email:

blocks.zh: 附件大小限制（通常 10–25 MB），大型文件需分割
blocks.en: Attachment size limits (usually 10–25 MB), so large documents must be split

blocks.zh: 多封郵件來回後版本控制混亂（哪封是最新版？）
blocks.en: After many emails back and forth, version control becomes confused (which is the latest one?)

blocks.zh: 查驗員收件箱中混雜查驗文件和日常郵件，難以管理
blocks.en: Inspection documents get mixed with everyday email in the inspector's inbox, making them hard to manage

blocks.zh: 無法記錄查驗員是否已確認收到並可存取文件
blocks.en: There is no way to record whether the inspector has acknowledged receipt and can access the documents

blocks.zh: 難以追蹤哪些文件已提供、哪些待提供
blocks.en: It is hard to track which documents have been provided and which are still pending

blocks.zh: 正確做法：建立一個專屬的文件分享平台資料夾，按查驗員的請求編號分類。電子郵件僅用於通知「已上傳」，不用於傳輸文件本身。
blocks.en: The right approach: Set up a dedicated folder on the document-sharing platform, organized by the inspector's request number. Use email only to notify that "documents have been uploaded", not to transfer the documents themselves.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 查驗相關影片是否為 GMP 記錄？
blocks.en: Key Notes — Are Inspection-Related Videos GMP Records?

blocks.zh: 這是一個法律灰色地帶，需要法律顧問在查驗前釐清。PDA 的立場是：
blocks.en: This is a legal gray area that legal counsel needs to clarify before the inspection. PDA's position is:

blocks.zh: 通常不是 GMP 記錄：為查驗目的而製作的影片、照片、簡報
blocks.en: Usually not GMP records: videos, photos and presentations produced for the purpose of the inspection

blocks.zh: 可能是 GMP 記錄：若影片內容記載了 GMP 法規要求記錄的活動（例如，直播的無菌操作影片，若被要求作為合規證據保留）
blocks.en: Possibly GMP records: if the video content documents an activity for which GMP regulations require records (for example, a live-streamed aseptic operation, if it is required to be retained as compliance evidence)

blocks.zh: 建議在查驗前協議（Pre-Inspection Agreement）中明確約定：哪些影像資料需要保留、保留多久、以何種格式保存。
blocks.en: It is recommended to agree explicitly in the Pre-Inspection Agreement which image data must be retained, for how long, and in what format.

blocks.zh: 查驗員要求你分享過去 2 年所有偏差報告的清單（共約 800 筆）。你會選擇哪種格式和哪種分享方式？為什麼？
blocks.en: The inspector asks you to share a list of all deviation reports from the past 2 years (about 800 entries). Which format and which sharing method would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 你的公司習慣用 Outlook 電子郵件傳送文件。請說明為何本次虛擬查驗應改用文件分享平台，以及如何說服 IT 部門快速配置。
blocks.en: Your company is used to sending documents by Outlook email. Explain why this virtual inspection should switch to a document-sharing platform, and how you would persuade the IT department to set it up quickly.

blocks.zh: Topic D.3 — Planning for Effective Use of Technology（技術有效使用規劃）| p15
blocks.en: Topic D.3 — Planning for Effective Use of Technology | p15

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 兩種技術失敗模式：過度 vs. 臨場探索
blocks.en: Key Notes — Two Technology Failure Modes: Overkill vs. On-the-Spot Exploration

blocks.zh: PDA 點出了虛擬查驗中最常見的兩種技術失誤，兩者都是導致查驗延誤的主要原因：
blocks.en: PDA points out the two most common technology mistakes in virtual inspections, both of which are major causes of inspection delays:

blocks.zh: Technology Overkill（技術過度）：公司試圖展示最先進的技術平台，但查驗員不熟悉，HA 的 IT 政策也可能不允許安裝新軟體。結果：查驗員花 2 小時在設定帳號，而非審查 GMP 文件。
blocks.en: Technology Overkill: The company tries to showcase the most advanced technology platform, but the inspector is unfamiliar with it and the HA's IT policy may not allow installing new software. Result: the inspector spends 2 hours setting up an account instead of reviewing GMP documents.

blocks.zh: Technology Exploration（臨場探索）：查驗進行中突然說「我們來試試這個新功能」或「改用這個軟體更清楚」。結果：安裝失敗、不相容錯誤、查驗中斷 30–60 分鐘。
blocks.en: Technology Exploration: In the middle of the inspection someone suddenly says "let's try this new feature" or "this other software would be clearer". Result: installation failures, incompatibility errors, and the inspection interrupted for 30–60 minutes.

blocks.zh: 黃金原則：查驗當天使用的所有技術，都應是查驗前已充分測試並雙方確認的工具。No surprises.
blocks.en: Golden rule: All technology used on the day of the inspection should be tools that were fully tested before the inspection and confirmed by both sides. No surprises.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 30 分鐘查驗前技術測試協定
blocks.en: Practical Application — 30-Minute Pre-Inspection Technology Test Protocol

blocks.zh: 建議在查驗開始前 3–5 天執行以下測試（30–45 分鐘）：
blocks.en: It is recommended to run the following tests (30–45 minutes) 3–5 days before the inspection begins:

blocks.zh: 視訊平台測試：確認 HA 查驗員可以登入，畫質和音質符合要求
blocks.en: Video platform test: Confirm that the HA inspectors can log in and that picture and sound quality meet requirements

blocks.zh: 文件平台測試：上傳測試文件，確認查驗員可存取和下載
blocks.en: Document platform test: Upload a test document and confirm that the inspector can access and download it

blocks.zh: GMP 軟體存取測試：在查驗將使用的電腦上確認 MES、LIMS、環監系統等可以正常開啟
blocks.en: GMP software access test: On the computers to be used in the inspection, confirm that MES, LIMS, the environmental monitoring system and so on open normally

blocks.zh: 網路連線測試：測試生產區域、實驗室、倉儲等現場連線穩定性
blocks.en: Network connection test: Test connection stability in the production areas, laboratories, warehouse and other locations on site

blocks.zh: 備用電話線測試：撥打測試通話，確認若網路中斷仍可溝通
blocks.en: Backup phone line test: Place a test call to confirm that communication is still possible if the network goes down

blocks.zh: 防毒軟體相容性確認：確認防毒軟體不會封鎖視訊平台或文件分享工具
blocks.en: Antivirus compatibility check: Confirm that the antivirus software does not block the video platform or document-sharing tools

blocks.zh: 測試完成後，製作一份「技術就緒確認清單（Technology Readiness Checklist）」並雙方簽署，作為查驗前協議的附件。
blocks.en: After the tests are complete, prepare a "Technology Readiness Checklist" signed by both sides, to be attached to the pre-inspection agreement.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 不在音樂會上調音
blocks.en: Analogy — You Don't Tune the Instruments During the Concert

blocks.zh: 專業的管弦樂團不會在音樂會正式開始後才開始調音——他們在後台就已經準備好，上台前最後確認一次。
blocks.en: A professional orchestra does not start tuning after the concert has begun. They are ready backstage and do one last check before going on stage.

blocks.zh: 遠端查驗的技術測試就是「調音」。查驗當天是「演出」，不是排練。查驗員不是來幫你測試設備的。
blocks.en: The technology test for a remote inspection is the "tuning". The day of the inspection is the "performance", not the rehearsal. The inspector is not there to help you test your equipment.

blocks.zh: Topic D.4 — Pre-Inspection Agreements（查驗前協議）| p16
blocks.en: Topic D.4 — Pre-Inspection Agreements | p16

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 錄影錄音：未經明確授權即為禁止
blocks.en: Key Notes — Audio and Video Recording: Prohibited Without Express Authorization

blocks.zh: 這是遠端查驗合規風險最高的一個議題。請注意 PDA 使用的語言非常強烈：「unless... the health authority has expressly granted permission（除非 HA 明確授予許可）」。
blocks.en: This is the topic with the highest compliance risk in remote inspections. Note that the language PDA uses is very strong: "unless... the health authority has expressly granted permission".

blocks.zh: 為什麼禁止錄影？
blocks.en: Why is recording prohibited?

blocks.zh: 查驗員的問話和討論屬於執法活動，受到保密義務保護
blocks.en: The inspector's questions and discussions are law enforcement activities and are protected by confidentiality obligations

blocks.zh: 未經 HA 書面同意錄影，可能被視為妨礙執法行為，導致更嚴格的後果
blocks.en: Recording without the HA's written consent may be regarded as obstructing enforcement, leading to harsher consequences

blocks.zh: 部分國家（例如台灣、德國）有嚴格的個人影像隱私法，在他人未知情下錄影可能違法
blocks.en: Some countries (for example Taiwan and Germany) have strict personal image privacy laws, and recording someone without their knowledge may be illegal

blocks.zh: 特別警告：Microsoft Teams、Zoom 等平台的「會議自動錄製」功能，若未事先關閉或通知查驗員，可能在不知情下觸法。在查驗前務必確認平台設定，並在查驗前協議中明確說明錄製功能狀態。
blocks.en: Special warning: The "automatic meeting recording" function of platforms such as Microsoft Teams and Zoom, if not switched off beforehand or disclosed to the inspector, may lead you to break the law unknowingly. Before the inspection, be sure to check the platform settings, and state the status of the recording function explicitly in the pre-inspection agreement.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 查驗前協議的核心要素清單
blocks.en: Practical Application — Checklist of Core Elements of a Pre-Inspection Agreement

blocks.zh: 一份完整的遠端查驗前協議（Pre-Inspection Agreement）應涵蓋以下要素：
blocks.en: A complete remote Pre-Inspection Agreement should cover the following elements:

blocks.zh: 使用的視訊通訊平台名稱及版本
blocks.en: Name and version of the video communication platform used

blocks.zh: 使用的文件分享平台名稱及存取控制規則
blocks.en: Name of the document-sharing platform used and its access control rules

blocks.zh: 查驗員的下載/列印權限（是否允許、範圍）
blocks.en: Inspector's download/print permissions (whether allowed, and to what extent)

blocks.zh: 文件保留期限和查驗後處置方式
blocks.en: Document retention period and post-inspection disposition

blocks.zh: 保密控制規定（哪些資訊受保護）
blocks.en: Confidentiality control provisions (which information is protected)

blocks.zh: 網路安全要求（加密標準、存取日誌）
blocks.en: Cybersecurity requirements (encryption standard, access logs)

blocks.zh: 錄影錄音規定（明確禁止或明確授權）
blocks.en: Audio and video recording rules (explicitly prohibited or explicitly authorized)

blocks.zh: 個人影像隱私處理（Data Protection Officer 確認）
blocks.en: Handling of personal image privacy (confirmed by the Data Protection Officer)

blocks.zh: 適用法律管轄（尤其是跨國查驗）
blocks.en: Applicable governing law (especially for cross-border inspections)

blocks.zh: 各方法律顧問簽署確認
blocks.en: Signed confirmation by each party's legal counsel

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 就像工程合約的施工前確認會議
blocks.en: Analogy — Like the Pre-Construction Meeting for an Engineering Contract

blocks.zh: 大型工程開工前一定有「施工前確認會議（Pre-Construction Meeting）」，雙方確認施工規範、安全規定、驗收標準。這份會議記錄不是形式——它是後續所有爭議的仲裁基準。
blocks.en: Before a major construction project begins there is always a "Pre-Construction Meeting" where both sides confirm the construction specifications, safety rules and acceptance criteria. The minutes of this meeting are not a formality; they are the arbitration baseline for every later dispute.

blocks.zh: 遠端查驗前協議也是同樣作用：它不是官僚程序，而是保護雙方（HA 和受查廠）的法律護盾。
blocks.en: The remote pre-inspection agreement serves the same function: it is not a bureaucratic procedure but a legal shield protecting both sides (the HA and the inspected site).

blocks.zh: Topic E.1 — Preparing Necessary Documents（必要文件的準備）| p17
blocks.en: Topic E.1 — Preparing Necessary Documents | p17

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 查驗就緒文件：哪些應常時保持數位格式？
blocks.en: Practical Application — CDMO Inspection-Readiness Documents: Which Should Be Kept in Digital Format at All Times?

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，「隨時查驗就緒（Always Inspection-Ready）」不是口號，而是商業競爭力。以下文件應在日常工作中即維持可立即分享的數位格式：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, "Always Inspection-Ready" is not a slogan but a source of commercial competitiveness. The following documents should be kept in a digital format that can be shared immediately as part of day-to-day work:

blocks.zh: A 級：24 小時內應可提供（高頻請求）
blocks.en: Tier A: Should be available within 24 hours (frequently requested)

blocks.zh: Site Master File（最新版，PDF 可搜尋格式）
blocks.en: Site Master File (latest version, searchable PDF format)

blocks.zh: 過去 3 年查驗歷史摘要（按 HA 分類）
blocks.en: Summary of inspection history for the past 3 years (categorized by HA)

blocks.zh: CAPA 狀態總覽表（可過濾的 Excel/CSV）
blocks.en: CAPA status overview (filterable Excel/CSV)

blocks.zh: 偏差報告彙整（依嚴重性、部門、產品分類，可搜尋）
blocks.en: Deviation report summary (categorized by severity, department and product; searchable)

blocks.zh: SOP 清單（含版本號、最後修訂日期）
blocks.en: SOP list (with version numbers and last revision dates)

blocks.zh: B 級：48–72 小時內可提供（中頻請求）
blocks.en: Tier B: Available within 48–72 hours (moderately requested)

blocks.zh: APR（含批次統計、趨勢分析）
blocks.en: APR (with batch statistics and trend analysis)

blocks.zh: 關鍵 SOP 修訂歷史 + 訓練記錄
blocks.en: Revision history of key SOPs + training records

blocks.zh: 環境監控趨勢報告（過去 12 個月）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring trend report (past 12 months)

blocks.zh: 廠區平面圖（含 ISO 等級標示、物料流向）
blocks.en: Site floor plan (with ISO classification marked and material flow)

blocks.zh: C 級：需臨時準備的深度文件
blocks.en: Tier C: In-depth documents that need to be prepared on short notice

blocks.zh: 特定批次的 BMR/BPR（依 HA 請求調取）
blocks.en: BMR/BPR of specific batches (retrieved on HA request)

blocks.zh: 驗證資料（IQ/OQ/PQ 報告）
blocks.en: Validation data (IQ/OQ/PQ reports)

blocks.zh: 調查報告全文
blocks.en: Full-text investigation reports

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 廠區圖的「定向」功能
blocks.en: Key Concept — The "Orientation" Function of Site Plans

blocks.zh: PDA 特別建議，在虛擬導覽影片和照片中，應在廠區平面圖上標記拍攝位置（marked on the site schematics）。這個細節非常重要：
blocks.en: PDA specifically recommends that in virtual tour videos and photos, the shooting locations be marked on the site schematics. This detail is very important:

blocks.zh: 查驗員看到一個無菌充填設備的影片，如果不知道它在哪個廠房、哪個樓層、哪個 ISO 等級的區域，他無法評估是否符合隔離屏障要求。
blocks.en: If an inspector sees a video of aseptic filling equipment but does not know which building, which floor or which ISO classification area it is in, the inspector cannot assess whether it meets barrier isolation requirements.

blocks.zh: 最佳做法：製作一份「查驗導覽圖（Inspection Navigation Map）」，標示每張照片/影片的拍攝位置，並與 Site Master File 中提交給 HA 的圖紙版本保持一致，避免資料完整性疑慮。
blocks.en: Best practice: Prepare an "Inspection Navigation Map" that marks the shooting location of every photo/video, and keep it consistent with the version of the drawings submitted to the HA in the Site Master File, to avoid data integrity concerns.

blocks.zh: Topic E.2 — Sharing of Inspection Reports（查驗報告的分享）| p18
blocks.en: Topic E.2 — Sharing of Inspection Reports | p18

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — PIC/S 查驗依賴框架與 MRA
blocks.en: Key Concept — The PIC/S Inspection Reliance Framework and MRAs

blocks.zh: PIC/S（Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme，藥品查驗合作計畫）是一個國際互相認可查驗結果的框架。目前有 50+ 個 HA 成員（包括 EMA、FDA、TGA、MHLW 等）。
blocks.en: PIC/S (Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme) is a framework for international mutual recognition of inspection results. It currently has 50+ HA members (including EMA, FDA, TGA, MHLW and others).

blocks.zh: MRA（Mutual Recognition Agreement，相互認可協議）：兩個 HA 之間的雙邊協議，允許一方直接採用另一方的查驗結果，無需重複查驗。
blocks.en: MRA (Mutual Recognition Agreement): A bilateral agreement between two HAs that allows one party to adopt the other's inspection results directly, without repeating the inspection.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的實務意義是：一次優秀的 FDA 查驗結果，可能幫助你在 EMA 查驗中獲得較寬鬆的對待；反之，一次 EMA 的 483 觀察項目，可能在 FDA 查驗員的手機裡已經看過了。
blocks.en: The practical significance for a CDMO is this: a good FDA inspection outcome may help you get more lenient treatment in an EMA inspection; conversely, an EMA 483-type observation may already have been seen on the FDA inspector's phone.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 分享查驗報告前，先檢查保密條款
blocks.en: Key Notes — Check the Confidentiality Clauses Before Sharing Inspection Reports

blocks.zh: 這是許多公司在虛擬查驗中容易犯的錯誤：查驗員要求你提供某 HA 的查驗報告，你直接傳過去——但這份報告的末頁有一行小字：「本報告內容不得向第三方揭露（Non-disclosure clause）」。
blocks.en: This is a mistake many companies easily make in virtual inspections: the inspector asks you to provide another HA's inspection report and you send it straight over, but the last page of that report has a line of small print: "The content of this report may not be disclosed to third parties (Non-disclosure clause)".

blocks.zh: 後果可能是：
blocks.en: The consequences may be:

blocks.zh: 違反與原發文 HA 的保密約定，影響未來合作關係
blocks.en: Breach of the confidentiality arrangement with the issuing HA, affecting the future working relationship

blocks.zh: 若該 HA 有行政管轄權，可能面臨罰款或其他處分
blocks.en: If that HA has administrative jurisdiction, you may face fines or other sanctions

blocks.zh: 正確流程：收到報告分享請求後，先確認：(1) 兩個 HA 之間是否有 MRA；(2) 報告是否有 Non-disclosure 條款；(3) 若有疑慮，聯繫法律顧問並向原發文 HA 申請授權分享。
blocks.en: Correct process: After receiving a request to share a report, first confirm: (1) whether there is an MRA between the two HAs; (2) whether the report has a non-disclosure clause; (3) if in doubt, contact legal counsel and ask the issuing HA for authorization to share.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 成績單的分享規則
blocks.en: Analogy — The Rules for Sharing a Transcript

blocks.zh: 你的成績單（查驗報告）是由學校（HA）發給你的，但它不自動屬於你的財產，你不能任意分享給其他人。就像求職時雇主（另一個 HA）要求看你的成績單，你需要先確認學校的隱私政策，必要時請學校出具同意書。
blocks.en: Your transcript (the inspection report) was issued to you by the school (the HA), but it does not automatically become your property, and you cannot share it with anyone you like. It is like an employer (another HA) asking to see your transcript when you apply for a job: you need to check the school's privacy policy first and, if necessary, ask the school to issue a consent letter.

blocks.zh: Topic E.3 — Timelines for Sharing Documentation（文件提交時程）| p19
blocks.en: Topic E.3 — Timelines for Sharing Documentation | p19

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 文件無法提供時的正確處理方式
blocks.en: Key Notes — The Right Way to Handle Documents That Cannot Be Provided

blocks.zh: 這個情況比想像中常見。例如：查驗員要求查看 5 年前的某批次記錄，但公司正在進行系統遷移，或文件在異地倉儲尚未數位化。
blocks.en: This situation is more common than you might think. For example: the inspector asks to see a batch record from 5 years ago, but the company is migrating its systems, or the document is in off-site storage and has not been digitized.

blocks.zh: 錯誤做法：沉默，等文件找到了再說；或提供不完整的替代文件而不說明。
blocks.en: The wrong approach: Stay silent and say something only once the document has been found, or provide an incomplete substitute document without explanation.

blocks.zh: 正確做法：立即主動通知查驗員，說明：
blocks.en: The right approach: Notify the inspector immediately and proactively, explaining:

blocks.zh: 哪份文件無法提供
blocks.en: Which document cannot be provided

blocks.zh: 原因說明（例如：「目前正進行文件管理系統遷移，預計 YYYY/MM/DD 前完成整合，屆時可提供」）
blocks.en: The reason (for example: "A document management system migration is currently under way and integration is expected to be completed by YYYY/MM/DD, after which the document can be provided")

blocks.zh: 預計可提供的目標日期
blocks.en: The target date by which it is expected to be available

blocks.zh: 若有替代資訊，一併說明
blocks.en: Any alternative information available, stated together with the above

blocks.zh: 主動溝通展現誠信，比被動等待發現問題，更能維護與 HA 的信任關係。
blocks.en: Proactive communication demonstrates integrity and does more to preserve trust with the HA than passively waiting for the problem to be discovered.

blocks.zh: HA 傳來一個包含 45 個請求項目的文件清單，你評估需要分 4 批提交。你會如何告知查驗員，並建議什麼樣的提交計畫？
blocks.en: The HA sends a document list containing 45 request items, and you assess that you need to submit it in 4 batches. How would you tell the inspector, and what kind of submission plan would you propose?

blocks.zh: 查驗員使用序號 001–045 來標記其文件請求。你在組織文件分享平台的資料夾結構時應如何設計，以確保查驗員能快速找到對應文件？
blocks.en: The inspector numbers the document requests 001–045. How should you design the folder structure on the document-sharing platform so that the inspector can quickly find the corresponding documents?

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 時程協商的考量因素矩陣
blocks.en: Key Concept — Matrix of Factors for Timeline Negotiation

blocks.zh: 「10 個工作日或 2 個行事曆週」是一般原則，但實際時程應依以下因素彈性協商：
blocks.en: "10 working days or 2 calendar weeks" is the general principle, but the actual timeline should be negotiated flexibly according to the following factors:

blocks.zh: 協商技巧：在確認收到文件請求的第一封回覆中，即說明預計提交時程和分批計畫，讓 HA 有心理準備，避免後續催促。
blocks.en: Negotiation tip: In your first reply acknowledging receipt of the document request, state the expected submission timeline and batch plan right away, so the HA is prepared and does not need to chase you later.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Section Summary — Part I: Planning & Notification
blocks.en: Section Summary — Part I: Planning & Notification

blocks.zh: A.1：HA 以風險評估決定查驗類型；For-Cause 查驗和部分 PAI 通常不適合遠端進行；混合查驗是彈性解法
blocks.en: A.1: The HA decides the inspection type by risk assessment; For-Cause inspections and some PAIs are generally not suitable for remote conduct; hybrid inspection is the flexible solution

blocks.zh: B.1：強烈建議提前通知；桌面查驗以文件索取為起算、虛擬查驗以開幕會議為起算；通知後 2 週是關鍵準備窗口
blocks.en: B.1: Advance notification is strongly recommended; for a desktop inspection the clock starts at the document request, for a virtual inspection at the opening meeting; the 2 weeks after notification are the key preparation window

blocks.zh: B.2：遠端查驗使身分驗證更困難；任何可疑查驗通知均應向 HA 官方管道確認，防範工業間諜風險
blocks.en: B.2: Remote inspections make identity verification harder; any suspicious inspection notice should be confirmed through the HA's official channels to guard against industrial espionage

blocks.zh: C.1：指定單一 Remote Inspection Host 作為 SPOC，需具備調動資源的職權；核心現場團隊包括指定領導人、Host、IT 支援
blocks.en: C.1: Appoint a single Remote Inspection Host as SPOC, with the authority to mobilize resources; the core on-site team includes the Designated Leader, the Host and IT support

blocks.zh: C.2：虛擬查驗總工期可達現場查驗的 2–3 倍；議程應交替安排現場對話與離線文件準備；時區差異和文化溝通需特別關注
blocks.en: C.2: Total duration of a virtual inspection can be 2–3 times that of an on-site inspection; the agenda should alternate live conversation with offline document preparation; time-zone differences and cultural communication need special attention

blocks.zh: D.1：硬體必備項目（電腦、攝影機、音訊、VPN）；文件攝影機大幅降低現場記錄的掃描負擔；虛擬導覽設備需符合潔淨區和防爆區安全規範
blocks.en: D.1: Mandatory hardware items (computer, camera, audio, VPN); a document camera greatly reduces the scanning burden for on-site records; virtual tour equipment must meet safety requirements for cleanroom and explosion-protected areas

blocks.zh: D.2：文件應為可搜尋 PDF；使用文件分享平台而非電子郵件；查驗專用影像資料通常非 GMP 記錄，但需法律顧問確認
blocks.en: D.2: Documents should be searchable PDFs; use a document-sharing platform instead of email; image data produced for the inspection is usually not a GMP record, but legal counsel should confirm

blocks.zh: D.3：避免 Technology Overkill 和 Technology Exploration 兩大失敗模式；查驗前 3–5 天執行 30 分鐘技術測試
blocks.en: D.3: Avoid the two failure modes of Technology Overkill and Technology Exploration; run a 30-minute technology test 3–5 days before the inspection

blocks.zh: D.4：查驗前協議需書面化，涵蓋平台、保密、資料處置、DPO 確認；未經 HA 書面授權，嚴禁錄影錄音（含平台自動錄製）
blocks.en: D.4: The pre-inspection agreement must be in writing and cover platforms, confidentiality, data disposition and DPO confirmation; audio and video recording (including automatic platform recording) is strictly prohibited without written HA authorization

blocks.zh: E.1：維持常時查驗就緒的數位文件庫；虛擬導覽影片應搭配標示拍攝位置的廠區平面圖
blocks.en: E.1: Maintain a digital document library that is always inspection-ready; virtual tour videos should be accompanied by site floor plans marking the shooting locations

blocks.zh: E.2：分享其他 HA 查驗報告前，先確認 MRA 適用性和報告是否含保密條款，必要時諮詢法律顧問
blocks.en: E.2: Before sharing another HA's inspection report, confirm whether an MRA applies and whether the report contains a confidentiality clause, and consult legal counsel if necessary

blocks.zh: E.3：一般時程為 10 個工作日或 2 個行事曆週，可依情況協商；分批提交需主動告知；文件無法提供時應即時通知並說明原因和預計日期
blocks.en: E.3: The general timeline is 10 working days or 2 calendar weeks and can be negotiated as circumstances require; staged submissions must be communicated proactively; if a document cannot be provided, notify the inspector promptly and explain the reason and the expected date
